statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let phase := fun (p k n : ℕ) => Complex.exp (((angle p k n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ x p k : ℕ, 0
